[[Lieren]] & [[Loania]] (twin daughters) }} '''Dougan''' was a [[human]] [[paladin]] who fought with [[Kardan]] and [[Voldana]] during the [[Second War]] in battling the [[Old Horde|Horde]]. In the aftermath of the war, he settled near [[Grand Hamlet]] with his wife [[Adena]] and his twin baby girls: [[Loania]] and [[Lieren]]. Dougan set out with Kardan and Voldana to rescue several villagers who had been reported missing from investigating the cursed tower of [[Karazhan]]. However, he never made it out alive.{{questlong|Alliance|41|Errand for Quel'Danil}} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Paladin characters]] [[Category:Knights of the Silver Hand]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[Category:Lore characters]]
